Generative artificial intelligence

Bot-proofing your website
A guide on how to stop (some) AI bots from scraping your website.
Each AI Chatbot Has Its Own Distinctive Writing Style—Just as Humans Do
An article about chatbot idiolects. Also see "Idiosyncrasies in Large Language Models," a paper diving deeper into the topic.
Library Freedom's Free Resources
Resource list. Includes AI critical resources, including how to avoid AI
How to disable or avoid intrusive AI
Guide on disabiling and avoiding AI in your browser and general internet life
How to Spot AI Hallucinations Like a Reference Librarian
Guide on spotting when AI hallucinates references
Fandom has a hidden Generative AI Problem
An easy way to tell if writing was generated by Claude. Also see original thread on Twitter
SynthID Detector
Upload a file, and this will tell you if the file has a SynthID. A SynthID is an invisible AI watermark. Supports NVDIA, OpenAI, Google, and Kakao.
Wikipedia: Signs of AI writing
Wikipedians lay out some features of "writing" generated with artificial intelligence. Mainly focused on Wikipedia-specific signs but can be used more generally.
